title: U.S. imposes 25% Section 301 tariffs on most Brazilian imports, with broad exemptions
summary: The tariff takes effect July 22, 2026 and targets Brazil’s trade practices, but USTR’s carve-outs cover major categories like food, aerospace parts and some energy and medical goods; Brazil says it will pursue reciprocity-law and WTO talks while possible retaliation options are still unconfirmed.
